system_deps: MuJoCo 2.1 binaries and a C compiler for mujoco-py
install.notes: The gate and the fake backend need neither robohive nor MuJoCo: fake.py is pure Python and the gate never installs or imports the upstream package. Install robohive and MuJoCo only to serve the upstream environment (a backend name the class does not list), which was not run here.
